spec.name: isolated-landing
spec.intent:
Census @2f2a0238 (design and notebook at 2f2a0238); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number, count or observed behaviour cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Add no new test file: a new one must be classified in packages/canon/test/gate-convicts.test.ts, which no unit of this plan owns; extend the test files named in outputs. Run one test file inside its package with `pnpm exec vitest run ` (a `pnpm --filter test -- ` runs the whole suite). Realize the plan's clauses 'each unit is built in its own isolated worktree off that line' and 'never on the main line' at the one plan write every implementer makes, so the rule bites on every harness (note 'implementers edit the main checkout': three of five notebook-gaps implementers built in the operator's main checkout; nothing refused them). At 2f2a0238 `plan land --plan

--commit ` records any string as the commit (packages/runtime/src/capabilities/plan/dispatch.ts:406-407; verb surface :633; dispatch :769). CHANGE. While the unit's plan is bound, land refuses, writing nothing, (a) a commit the repository cannot resolve, (b) a commit the HEAD of the main checkout contains (the main worktree is RecordStore.main, packages/runtime/src/record-store/store.ts:218-236; a commit made there, on main or on a branch switched to in that checkout, is built in the main checkout), and (c) a commit the plan's line already contains (a unit built in the line's own worktree is not built in a worktree of its own); a commit made in another worktree on a branch off the line is recorded as today. The refusal says, in the plan's words, which of the three holds for which unit and commit, and that nothing was written; it names no git command, no branch and no worktree path, as the line refusal does (store.ts `lineless`, :301-312), because the design says how an agent uses worktrees is its own competence and nothing it reads teaches it. assay, whole and broke are unchanged, and land on a unit of a plan that is not bound refuses as today. packages/runtime/README.md says what land refuses where it describes land. .changeset/isolated-landing.md: patch for @cratylus/runtime and cratylus.
accept: in packages/runtime, `pnpm exec vitest run test/plan.test.ts` exits 0, including cases on a temp repository with a bound plan: a land of a commit made on the main checkout's branch, a land of a commit the line's worktree made on the line, and a land of a name that resolves to no commit each refuse; each output says nothing was written and contains none of `git `, `plan/<plan>` and the line's worktree path, and the unit's ledger is the same after as before; a land of a commit made in a separate worktree on a branch cut from the line is recorded in the ledger
the three refusal cases, run against packages/runtime/src at 2f2a0238 (the unit's test file over the old source), fail; print that failing run
in packages/runtime, `pnpm exec vitest run test/note.test.ts test/record-store.test.ts` exits 0, and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/runtime typecheck` exits 0
`grep -n -i 'land' packages/runtime/README.md` prints a line saying land refuses a commit the main checkout or the plan's line already holds; at 2f2a0238 no line says so
